items.title: Parallel Decisions now available on AI Gateway for free
items.summary: from Parallel is now available on  and is free through November 23, 2026.Parallel Decisions FastAI GatewayIt searches the live web to answer typed questions about companies, products, policies, and other changing information, returning probabilities and cited evidence for your application to act on.Use it to enrich CRM records, check eligibility, route leads, or verify claims against current sources. Boolean questions return the probability of yes, Choice questions select from options you define, and Score questions assess an ordered rubric. Related questions share context and retrieved evidence in one request.Use  as the model name. No separate Parallel account is required. These examples ask the same web-grounded question through the AI SDK, TypeSafe-compatible API, and OpenAI-compatible Decisions API.parallel/parallel-decisions-fastCitations include source URLs, optional titles, and evidence excerpts. They apply to the whole request, rather than mapping individual sources to each answer. Your application can use answer probabilities to act automatically above a threshold and send uncertain results for review.AI Gateway tracks these requests in  and  alongside other model requests.
